WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.district_id,
    step1.cnt,
    CAST(step1.cnt AS REAL) / step2.total_cnt as proportion
  FROM step1, step2
  WHERE step2.total_cnt IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion
  FROM step3
)
SELECT 
  step3.district_id,
  step3.cnt,
  step3.proportion,
  step3.proportion - step4.avg_proportion as diff
FROM step3, step4
WHERE step4.avg_proportion IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10
